nodes.label: Repository map and the notebook-carries-the-package rule
nodes.rationale: USAGE section 2. The notebook carries the package (D54, D58): definition cells create each module in the kernel namespace, so a Kaggle session needs the notebook and BTCUSDT_1h.parquet and nothing else. Hand-editing a package cell is a defect; the next generator run reverts it silently. tools/build_notebook.py sits outside the package on purpose — it is build tooling, and nothing under src/ may import it.

nodes.label: config.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Design constants; the derived 15-origin grid; FalsificationOrigin. Key guarantee it enforces: The grid is derived, never transcribed — a stale integer cannot survive a spacing change.

nodes.label: segments.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Loads the artifact; the segment law; break measurement. Key guarantee it enforces: Raises if the frame reaches outside the half-open data window (D33).

nodes.label: windows.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Timestamp-validated window enumeration. Key guarantee it enforces: Raises on any window failing t[s+L+H-1] - t[s] == (L+H-1) hours — the defence against positional-index drift.

nodes.label: budget.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Per-origin/per-block window accounting. Key guarantee it enforces: CLAUDE.md section 11's exact-equality assertion target; asserted against the pooled 4.9% it fires spuriously at fourteen of fifteen origins.

nodes.label: features.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: The twelve variates, per bar, in ladder order. Key guarantee it enforces: Raises on any non-finite variate — impossible unless the segment law did not run. Column order IS ladder order, so rung K is exactly the first K columns and r is channel 0 at every rung.

nodes.label: splits.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Window semantics per split; the scaler; the tensors. Key guarantee it enforces: Raises if a training target reaches into validation (D24). Two window semantics differing by exactly 119 windows: 'contained' for train/validation, 'origin' for test blocks (D51b).

nodes.label: model.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Encoder-only iTransformer plus the uniform-attention arm. Key guarantee it enforces: Returns the target channel alone, so the loss is single-channel by construction (D39).

nodes.label: train.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Training loop; run identity; the two artifacts. Key guarantee it enforces: GPU-resident, no DataLoader; LR halves every 4 epochs (D47).

nodes.label: keff.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: The pre-model measurement and the Stage 3b gate. Key guarantee it enforces: Every K_eff is computed on a training-only span (D44); the gate additionally uses the pre-first-origin span (D02).

nodes.label: metrics.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: Every metric, test and RQ estimator. Key guarantee it enforces: Ratio metrics come from seed-averaged MSEs, never averaged ratios (D42).

nodes.label: baselines.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: The comparators: ridge, DLinear, PatchTST, LSTM, two naive. Key guarantee it enforces: Writes through train.write_artifacts, never its own schema; D45 window alignment is asserted, not assumed.

nodes.label: runner.py guarantee
nodes.rationale: Responsibility: The manifest; resume; budget guard; execute_parallel across every visible GPU. Key guarantee it enforces: Shards the FULL manifest, then subtracts what is done (D53c) — sharding the pending list races two workers against each other.

nodes.label: Stage 1 — ingest
nodes.rationale: spot_klines_btc.py writes the four immutable artifacts. Re-running changes the vintage and section 12 forbids comparing across vintages. --end is exclusive; clip_to_window() enforces it (D33). Expected: 75,216 expected / 75,094 actual bars, 99.8378% coverage, 27 gap blocks, parquet sha256 8270a84b07c2923b.

nodes.label: Stage 2 — segments and the window budget
nodes.rationale: load_bars + usable_mask + budget_table. 75,094 rows, 75,091 usable; exactly 3 unusable bars and they are the same 3 in all three senses. The assertion is exact equality per origin, never against the pooled 4.9%.

nodes.label: Stage 3 — features
nodes.rationale: build_features(bars): 75,091 usable bars -> 75,062 feature rows, 29 dropped, one per segment because r is computed per segment (D52c).

nodes.label: Stage 3b — effective dimensionality and the gate
nodes.rationale: keff.gate_verdict / keff.keff_table. Measured PR 1.00 / 3.33 / 4.27 / 3.98 against the design's 1 / ~3.5 / ~6.5 / ~7. Gate PR at K=8 is 4.393 < 5.0 so the gate does NOT pass; D48's action is disclosure, not a re-cut. K=12's PR is below K=8's, so the redundancy control is stronger than designed, and corr(K, K_eff) = 0.828 makes RQ1's horse race more identifiable.

nodes.label: Stage 4 — pre-flight invariants
nodes.rationale: Three checks, each of which failed the first time it ran: MSE(c*x)/c^2 == MSE(x) (the source spec's form cannot pass); single-batch overfit at dropout=0.0 (~1e-10, versus a 7e-2 floor with dropout on, D52d); Naive-RW mapped as y_z = -mu_g/sigma_g, not 0 (D31).

nodes.label: Stage 5 — the pilot gate, on validation
nodes.rationale: runner.stage5_pilot: 12 runs, origin 1, 4 K x 3 seeds, judged on the validation sub-block never on test (D27). The statistic is Clark-West, not Diebold-Mariano, because the pair is nested (D29).

nodes.label: Stage 6 — the grid
nodes.rationale: Arms with their tags: main itr_ 300, uniform itru_ 75, fresh itrf_ 15, horizon itr_ 144 (48 shared run_ids deduplicated, D53e), ridge rdg_ 60, dlinear dlin_ 45, patchtst ptst_ 45. Two GPUs are two workers; in the notebook they are two threads (D68). nn.DataParallel and DDP both rejected — parallelism belongs at the run level. No Dataset, no DataLoader, no workers.

nodes.label: Stage 7 — evaluation
nodes.rationale: gather_grid -> seed_average, then per RQ: RQ1 tost_equivalence + j_test; RQ2 amplification + panel_beta1; RQ3 decay + b_star + kaplan_meier. Four traps handled: order of operations (seed-averaged MSEs first), the error bar bound to aggregation level (D30), beta1's effective n is the cluster count G = 15 with effective independence near 4 (D28), and a restricted studentized one-sided bootstrap at B = 99,999 whose p-value floors at 1/(B+1) (D53d).

nodes.label: Stage 8 — save
nodes.rationale: artifacts/paper_numbers.json plus five parquet tables. Every table and figure in the manuscript is generated from that file, never transcribed.

nodes.label: `python -m pytest tests/ -q`
nodes.rationale: One command to check the repo is sound — 59 passed, ~13 s, CPU only. USAGE section 9: run the tests first; they found D51, D52 and D53.

nodes.label: `python tools/build_notebook.py`
nodes.rationale: One command after editing src/ — the notebook carries the package (D54). Then pytest tests/test_notebook_sync.py, then commit src/ and the notebook together.

nodes.label: `python tools/notebook_to_src.py`
nodes.rationale: One command after editing a notebook cell: save the notebook first, then run this — the return leg, verified byte-exact (D88). It reads the file on disk, not the live kernel.

nodes.label: `python tools/build_notebook.py --preserve-outputs <exported.ipynb>`
nodes.rationale: Keeping a Kaggle run's outputs: carried onto byte-identical cells only (D86). Never commit the Kaggle export over the generated notebook (D61).

nodes.label: `python -m itransformer_btc.runner --shard 0 --shards 1`
nodes.rationale: One command to run experiments. Flags: --shard/--shards (round-robin BY GROUP so a cell's seeds share one tensor build), --arms, --parquet, --out, --budget-h/--reserve-h checked at run boundaries.

nodes.label: `python tools/build_report.py`
nodes.rationale: Writes paper/{paper_numbers.json,tables,figures,panels}. CPU only, ~4 minutes at the full bootstrap; --check is the drift guard; --bootstrap-b 199 for a fast pass.

nodes.label: run_id = {model}_o{origin}_K{K}_H{H}_s{seed}
nodes.rationale: e.g. itr_o07_K08_H024_s42, itru_o01_K08_H024_s43, itrf_o01_K08_H024_s42. Deterministic and human-readable; changing any component deliberately ORPHANS prior outputs rather than silently reusing a mismatched result.

nodes.label: artifacts/preds/{run_id}.parquet schema
nodes.rationale: block Int8 (1-6; the falsification arm carries 4,5,6 as labels not positions), step Int16 (1..H), timestamp Int64 epoch ms UTC of the WINDOW START (the first target hour is start + L), y_true and y_pred Float32 standardised log-returns. Because L = 96 is a multiple of 24, hour-of-day is preserved, which is what makes the 00:00 UTC non-overlapping phase selectable by timestamp // 3.6e6 % 24 == 0 (D46).

nodes.label: artifacts/meta/{run_id}.json schema
nodes.rationale: Resolved config plus git_sha, code_sha256, input_parquet, input_sha256, input_sha256_source, origin, origin_index, block_labels, k, variates, n_train, n_val, n_test_per_block, mu_g, sigma_g, mu_over_sigma, naive_rw_z, epochs_run, best_val_mse, train_loss, wall_time_s, n_parameters, device, status. git_sha is 'unknown' on Kaggle, so code_sha256 is what identifies the code section 12 requires every number to resolve to (D54b).

nodes.label: Expected numbers — telling a break from a change
nodes.rationale: 75,094 bars / 75,091 usable / 3 unusable; 75,062 feature rows; 15 origins 2020-01..2025-11 at 5-month spacing; 13,545..15,217 training windows on the feature frame (the assertion target); largest training tensor 70.12 MB; 280,472 parameters identical at every rung; 0% test-block loss at 74 of 90 cells, worst 439/720; gate PR at K=8 = 4.393; first measured run itr_o01_K08_H024_s42 at RelMSE 1.0183, R2_oos -0.0183. That last row is worth watching: D20 anticipated +0.004.

nodes.label: Running on Kaggle — Save & Run All, never the editor
nodes.rationale: Attach the data Dataset only, Accelerator GPU T4 x2, then Save Version -> Save & Run All. Discovery is by globbing, never by dataset slug. Do NOT attach the repository and do not add src/ to sys.path — the notebook asserts 'itransformer_btc' not in sys.modules and fails loudly, because an on-path copy shadowing the definition cells would make every number traceable to code that is not in the cells above. Never the interactive editor: the 20-minute idle timeout kills long sessions and hitting the 12 h wall interactively loses /kaggle/working entirely.

nodes.label: Session chaining and mid-grid resume
nodes.rationale: Session N writes to /kaggle/working; Save Version publishes it as a Dataset; session N+1 attaches it as input. At most ONE run is lost (~30 s) because an interrupted run leaves no meta. pending() = manifest - completed matched by run_id, roots discovered by glob over /kaggle/input/*/preds and /kaggle/input/*/*/preds. Two guards: evaluation cells gated on GRID_COMPLETE (D54e) because a half-panel beta1 is a different estimand not a noisier one, and the budget guard bounds the SESSION not the worker (D54f).

nodes.label: Troubleshooting table — symptom to cause
nodes.rationale: Nine named failures with their causes, ending in the rule that carries the rest: a result that looks too good is LEAKAGE until proven otherwise. 'ValueError: the purge did not hold' is a real leak and the assertion must not be loosened; 'unbalanced panel' means finish the grid, because beta1's within-slope identity needs balance.
